aboutGame.title: What is Survive The Hulk?
paragraphs: Survive The Hulk is an asymmetric multiplayer survival horror game on Roblox. One player is chosen to become the Hulk while everyone else hides, escapes, and scrambles through a destructible facility until the round timer runs out. The monster wins by eliminating the lobby, and the survivors win by simply staying alive when time expires.

Rounds reward planning over reflexes. Survivors break line of sight through vents and windows, manage a draining stamina bar, and learn which walls the Hulk can smash. Players who want to fight back can buy the Hulkbuster armor with Robux and equip it before spawning as a survivor, turning a one-sided chase into a short, heavy counterattack.

modules.name: Survive The Hulk Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the core rules of Survive The Hulk, including how rounds work, how players are assigned as the Hulk or survivors, and how to win each role. Introduce essential survival tactics, monster abilities, and the basics of using the destructible environment.

highlights.detail: Learn the round loop: one player is picked as the Hulk while everyone else hides until the timer expires
Set your role goal, since the Hulk wins by eliminating the lobby and survivors win by staying alive
Master stamina first, because sprinting drains it and an empty bar ends most beginner chases
Hide in connected interiors with more than one exit instead of single-door closets
Break line of sight with vents, windows, and destructible walls whenever the Hulk closes in
Give every round one practice goal, such as surviving the full timer without sprinting blindly

modules.name: Survive The Hulk Survivor Tips
modules.description: Explain how survivors can avoid the Hulk, use hiding places and ventilation shafts, navigate the facility, and cooperate with teammates. Include practical movement and escape strategies to help beginners survive until the round ends.

highlights.label: Routes
highlights.detail: Plan two escape routes before the chase starts and never sprint in a straight line

highlights.label: Vents
highlights.detail: Crawl through ventilation shafts to break line of sight and reset a chase

highlights.label: Stamina
highlights.detail: Sprint in short bursts, because a drained stamina bar is what gets survivors caught

highlights.label: Sound
highlights.detail: Listen for footsteps and breaking walls before the Hulk reaches your room

highlights.label: Spread
highlights.detail: Stay spread out so the ground slam and shockwave clap cannot hit the whole group

highlights.label: Timer
highlights.detail: Play for time, since every second you stay alive is a second closer to a survivor win

modules.name: Survive The Hulk Hulk Abilities
modules.description: Cover the Hulk's combat mechanics, including punch combos, sprint attacks, destructive thunder clap attacks, and the ability to locate hiding players. Explain how to use these abilities to pursue survivors and control the arena efficiently.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Leap and ground slam, the best chase and space-control tools in the monster kit

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Grab and throw plus environment smashing, for guaranteed eliminations and removed hiding spots

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Shockwave clap and rage escalation, both strong but slow or entirely passive

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Roar, an information tool for the first seconds of a round rather than a damage dealer

modules.name: Survive The Hulk Hulkbuster Guide
modules.description: Explain how the Hulkbuster helps survivors fight back with heavy punches and repulsor blasts. Cover its role in combat, when to engage the Hulk, and how to balance attacking with staying alive.

highlights.detail: Open the shop from the lobby or the in-game menu
Find the Hulkbuster entry in the abilities or premium section
Complete the Robux purchase, since the armor is not a level or drop reward
Equip the Hulkbuster in your inventory before joining a new round
Confirm you spawned as a survivor, because the Hulk cannot use the suit
Activate it when the Hulk commits to a chase, not once you are already cornered

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Survive The Hulk.

items.question: What is Survive The Hulk?
items.answer: Survive The Hulk is an asymmetric multiplayer survival horror game on Roblox. One player is chosen to become the Hulk and hunt the lobby, while everyone else hides, escapes, and tries to survive until the round timer expires.

items.question: How do you win a round of Survive The Hulk?
items.answer: It depends on your role. The Hulk wins by eliminating every survivor before the timer ends, while survivors win by simply staying alive until time runs out. Numbers only help the survivors if they spread out and communicate.

items.question: Does Survive The Hulk have codes?
items.answer: Survive The Hulk has no confirmed working codes right now, so nothing can be redeemed this week. Free cash and cosmetics come from surviving full rounds, completing daily objectives, and claiming the first win of the day.

items.question: How do you get the Hulkbuster in Survive The Hulk?
items.answer: The Hulkbuster is a premium Robux purchase rather than a level or drop reward. Buy it from the shop, equip it in your inventory before joining a round, and activate it during the match while playing as a survivor.

items.question: What is the best way to escape the Hulk?
items.answer: Plan two routes before the chase starts, sprint in short bursts to protect your stamina, and use vents, windows, and destructible walls to break the Hulk's line of sight. A survivor with a backup plan outlasts a faster player who runs blindly.

items.question: Is Survive The Hulk free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Survive The Hulk is free to play on Roblox, and Robux is only needed for optional premium content such as the Hulkbuster armor.
